primary.title: Levi Strauss shares slip ahead of Q2 earnings report as investors await impact of FIFA World Cup campaign
primary.summary: Analysts expect Levi Strauss to report earnings of 24 cents per share on revenue of $1.52 billion, representing year-over-year growth of 9% and 8.6%, respectively
